# Friend of a Friend (FOAF) vocabulary

> The Friend of a Friend (FOAF) RDF vocabulary, described using W3C RDF Schema and the Web Ontology Language.

- Ontology IRI: http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/
- Namespace: http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/ (prefix `foaf:`)
- Contents: 14 classes, 34 object properties, 27 datatype properties, 10 annotation properties

Terms are identified by IRI; use the CURIEs and labels below when writing SPARQL or RDF.

## Documentation

- [Overview](index.md): metadata and contents
- [Classes](classes.md): 14 classes with definitions and axioms
- [Object properties](object-properties.md): 34 object properties with definitions and axioms
- [Datatype properties](datatype-properties.md): 27 datatype properties with definitions and axioms
- [Annotation properties](annotation-properties.md): 10 annotation properties with definitions and axioms

## Machine-readable

- [ontology.json](ontology.json): all terms as JSON (IRI, label, definition, hierarchy, domain/range)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the complete documentation as one Markdown file
- [Turtle](ontology.ttl): the ontology source (text/turtle)
- [RDF/XML](ontology.owl): the ontology source (application/rdf+xml)
- [JSON-LD](ontology.jsonld): the ontology source (application/ld+json)
- [N-Triples](ontology.nt): the ontology source (application/n-triples)
